# Feature: Power switches (recipe) — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #91 (Power switches (recipe)) from Time, Gates and Exits before it is used in real levels. Effect: Three existing switches, all on at once, call the elevator; no new tile. Unique: three separate switches together replace the orb gate. Useful: a level goal spread across the whole map. Source status in the candidate file is 'revised'; it was revised from human review and is now treated as a trial candidate.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** three existing switches, all on at once, call the elevator; no new tile.

**So that** a level goal spread across the whole map.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Power switches (recipe) for the first time in its teaching room (mech-91-power-switches-recipe-room). Teaching moment: First room: the recipe built from one floor switch, one weight switch and one toggle, with the counter in the HUD. A player who sets two of them and steps off the floor switch to go and look at the gate watches the counter fall back to two, which teaches that the three have to be on together and that one of them therefore needs a block or a bot. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: This is a level recipe, not a new object: wire any three existing switches (floor, toggle or weight) to one gate, with a 0/3 to 3/3 counter in the HUD
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: The gate calls the elevator only while all three are on together, so a floor switch in the set forces a block or a bot into the design
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: No new tile or code beyond counting wired switches

## Edge Cases & Rules

- The gate calls the elevator only while all three are on together, so a floor switch in the set forces a block or a bot into the design
- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Power switches (recipe)'s effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-91-power-switches-recipe-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/time-gates-and-exits.yml mechanic #91.
